en: Vintage illustrated postcard showing an urban square with grand 19th‑century buildings. In the center is a large ornate hotel façade with flags flying on the roof and the sign "GRAND HOTEL"/"HOTEL NACIONAL". A tram pulled by horses, carriages, pedestrians, gas street lamps and a bridge or quay railing are visible in the foreground. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the place, and there is handwritten cursive text over the lower margin.
